Texas economics.goal: Build a customer offer, compare it with the existing contract and save a reusable workstream.
Texas economics.inputs: Customer/utility, pricing file and date, start/term, monthly volumes, supply components, transport, margin and current contract terms.
steps: Open a saved workstream or enter customer and pricing sources.
Verify monthly volumes and all supply/transport/capital assumptions.
Review the offer, estimated savings and sensitivity results.
Save the workstream; download the client proposal or all reports.
Texas economics.check: Confirm all monthly volumes, units and the exact pricing snapshot. Boltex uses the supplied calendar-month profile. Save confirmation should show expected total MMBtu and month count. The client PDF excludes internal margin and credit calculations.

Ohio economics.goal: Build and compare a DEO or Columbia acquisition campaign, then save the reviewed assumptions.
Ohio economics.inputs: Utility, customer count/mix, weather-normal or manual schedules, pricing file/date, transport/storage and actual offers.
steps: Open a saved Ohio workstream and choose the utility/source file.
Review customer mix, monthly load and storage schedule.
Compare model/actual offer economics, competition and missing-price treatment.
Save the campaign and download the summary or all reports.
Ohio economics.check: Ohio usage/offer units remain Mcf and quoted price units as disclosed by the app. Verify storage transfers, taxes, costs and any curve extension before publishing. New inputs must be saved explicitly.
